AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

3. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

5. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

7. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

8. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

9. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.

10. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

12. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities in Aviation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
